driver_dependency_manifest.text:
[package]
name = "aspis-r1-cu-probe"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
default-run = "aspis-r1-cu-probe"

[features]
r0-op-count = ["aspis-core/r0-op-count"]
private-leaf-salts = ["aspis-r1-cost-probe/private-leaf-salts"]

[workspace]

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.100"
aspis-core = { path = "../../crates/aspis-core", features = ["r0"] }
aspis-pool = { path = "../../programs/aspis-pool", features = ["no-entrypoint", "pair-forest-account-evidence", "pair-forest-verifier-lane-invariant-audit"] }
aspis-prover = { path = "../../crates/aspis-prover", features = ["r0", "insecure-spend-fixture"] }
aspis-r1-cost-probe = { path = "../../crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe", features = ["prover"] }
aspis-registry = { path = "../../programs/aspis-registry", features = ["no-entrypoint"] }
aspis-statement = { path = "../../crates/aspis-statement", features = ["r0", "pool-v1-kernel"] }
litesvm = "=0.16.0"
agave-feature-set = "=4.2.1"
solana-program-runtime = "=4.2.1"
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "=0.10.9"
solana-account = "=4.3.2"
solana-address = "=2.6.1"
solana-compute-budget = "=4.2.1"
solana-compute-budget-interface = "=3.0.0"
solana-instruction = "=3.4.0"
solana-keypair = "=3.1.2"
solana-message = { version = "=4.4.1", features = ["wincode"] }
solana-program = "=2.3.0"
solana-signer = "=3.0.1"
solana-transaction = { version = "=4.1.5", features = ["wincode"] }
wincode = "=0.5.5"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
